caption:
Brotherhood: Allah calls the believers brothers and asks us to make peace.

This verse names the believers as brothers and tells us to make peace between them, then to fear Allah so that we may be shown mercy. This evening, think of a rift that has gone on too long.

Surah Al-Hujuraat 49:10

Message one person tonight and take the first step to mend it.

#brotherhood #ummah #reconciliation #surahhujurat
alt_text: The believers are but brothers, so make peace between your brothers. And fear Allah, so that you may be shown mercy (Surah Al-Hujuraat 49:10)
